And well, I saw the writing on the wall, and, well, I joined the Terasology group. A permissively licensed FLOSS voxel engine. Every thing minecraft won't do/couldn't do/said was impossible. If there was a minecraft 4.0, it would be this.

It is so different than minecraft, that you can create your own fork of it and sell it, legally: its Apache2.0. Big contrast compared to selling game items is what causes the whole sell out to microsoft (as well as currently tearing the community apart).

Now back to Terasology: why its litterally the jesus of voxel engines compared to minecraft.

Well straite off the bat: mod support. In fact mod support is one of the main features. All content is added though modules, that you can offically download in the game GUI. Updates, downloads, the whole thing. Handles dependacies and all.

That means all content is togglable, and theres no "main version" they're pushing. All they focus on is good engine coding. There are currently 3 "version" that show in the drop down menu. (think of them like mod packs). Don't even have to manage them unless you're playing single player: joining a server automatically downloads them. (they're all sandboxed so no security worries). Modules are also handled per world: you select a world from a menu and the modules all get loaded. This is unlike even the best minecraft mod loader/handler, which needs a restart to switch mod packs and/or load unload mods.

Terasology also follows SemVer, meaning modules are compataible cross version. All modules will be cross version compatible for sure up to version 2.0. (its taken them around 4 or so years to get to version 1.0, so don't expect it soon).

And with this API, you can imagin modding is pretty easy and fun. Its a java + json mix. you can write mods all in json if a library for it already exists. (for example, to make new plants, its just a json file, a java plant growth library has already been written. We don't repeat work around here)

And then theres various other good stuff like block shape inheritence (every block comes in every shape defacto) better lighting (check out some screenshots of it), colored lighing, hand held/dropped lighting (such as holding or dropping a torch), etc.

and cubic chunks. Infinite height and depth, no sky limit or bed rock to hit. (and of course random other good stuff like better entity system, multithearded etc, basic VR support currently, etc, etc)

I saw that, went "holy shit" and now I contribute to it.
